eligible_resources.name: 211 — local community resources
eligible_resources.purpose: Find your local US 211 to research practical community support, including food and transportation assistance.
eligible_resources.limits: 211 provides information and referrals, not a booked service. Eligibility, prices and availability of referred programs vary. No check-in or emergency response is promised.

eligible_resources.name: Rover — pet sitter research
eligible_resources.purpose: Compare potential paid drop-in sitters for cats or dogs in your area before you need one.
eligible_resources.limits: Research is free; bookings cost money. Coverage, prices, pet types, experience and dates vary. A listing is not a confirmed booking or guarantee of suitability.

eligible_resources.name: Taskrabbit — shopping and errands
eligible_resources.purpose: Research paid practical help such as collecting dry cleaning or getting everyday supplies in supported locations.
eligible_resources.limits: Check coverage, included work, total charges and booking notice. No availability or suitability guarantee. Research does not book a service.

eligible_resources.name: Pet Sitters International — sitter finder
eligible_resources.purpose: Find member pet-care businesses to contact about future drop-in care, experience with the pet, notice and an introductory meeting.
eligible_resources.limits: PSI does not inspect or endorse listed businesses. Ask the provider about fees, visit notice, meeting first, and what happens if they cannot attend. A lead or inquiry is not agreed care.

cases.label: Returning user wants a useful preparation memo
cases.note: I have already sorted easy meals and my resting spot. I also checked my pharmacy delivery process and have its number saved. The information is scattered. Help me prepare one short private sick-day note I can actually use later, with useful headings. Please do not give me another food or shelf task.

request.note: I have already sorted easy meals and my resting spot. I also checked my pharmacy delivery process and have its number saved. The information is scattered. Help me prepare one short private sick-day note I can actually use later, with useful headings. Please do not give me another food or shelf task.

content.title: Give tomorrow-you two easy food options
content.summary: Pick familiar food you’d actually want, so a low-energy day involves one less decision.
steps: Look over food you already have or usually keep at home.
Choose two familiar options that take little preparation; note any ingredient missing from what you have.
Save their names and locations in your usual note, with missing ingredients on your next shopping list.
content.done_when: Two easy food options are noted, including what you have and anything missing.

content.title: Give your resting spot a little setup
content.summary: Keep everyday comforts close, using a shelf or basket and things you already own.
steps: Choose a reachable shelf or basket near where you like to rest.
Gather tissues, a charging cable and another everyday comfort you already use; keep the cable out of walking paths.
Put them together and note any missing item for your next usual shopping trip.
content.done_when: Your everyday comforts are together, with missing items noted.
